messages:
mira_cs: Heads up — AcmeRetail renewal flag. Embed traffic dropped ~67% last 7d and their integration lead reports getting 404 / model_not_found from our embeddings endpoint after an SDK upgrade. Can eng triage? @raj_eng @tom_ops :wave:

raj_eng: On it. Can you paste a failing request + approximate timestamps? Also, is text generation affected or just embeds?

mira_cs: Only embeds affected. Sample from customer (logs sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-2","input":"test"}'

# response: {"error":"model_not_found","message":"model 'rwd-embed-2' not found"}
```
Topline numbers: last week avg 1.2k/day -> now ~380/day, spike in 404s between 2024-11-28 14:00 - 2024-11-30 02:00 UTC. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/acmeretail/embeds (customer_shared_view)

tom_ops: deploy-bot checked infra deploys/rollbacks — no infra deploys or model removals in that window. No platform-wide incidents.

deploy-bot: No deploys to serving or catalog between 1802300000 and 1802468102.

raj_eng: 404 model_not_found usually means a model id mapping changed (catalog rename) or a per-tenant routing rule. Did the customer upgrade an SDK that renames model ids?

mira_cs: Customer confirmed they upgraded from sdk-js v1.2 -> v2.0 last week. Release notes for v2 mention renaming rwd-embed-2 -> rwd-embed-v2. They said their integration didn't touch model names, but their vendor wrapper may have.

olivia_ps: If the SDK renamed the canonical id, we should add a compatibility alias for affected tenants. Short-term: add an alias pointing old id -> current model for AcmeRetail. Medium: add a fallback mapping for legacy ids for 30d and a deprecation notice.

raj_eng: I can add a per-tenant routing fallback mapping (AcmeRetail: rwd-embed-2 -> rwd-embed-v2) in the routing service and canary it. Will push rule to canary and point at the current model. ETA ~2h.

mira_cs: Amazing — I'll tell the customer to retry after 2h and schedule a quick integration call with their lead at 10am PT. I'll also surface the deprecation plan. :pray:

deploy-bot: Canary rule created: routing/overrides/acmeretail/embeds -> {"rwd-embed-2":"rwd-embed-v2"}. Test harness traffic: success rate for previously failing payloads improved from 18% -> 78% on canary.

raj_eng: Canary looks good. I'll roll mapping to prod with a short windowed rollout and monitor 5m error rate. If stable, we keep alias active and draft migration email for accounts using legacy id.

mira_cs: Thanks team — I'll update the renewal playbook and notify AE. Scheduling follow-up after prod rollout. :thumbsup:
